{"consolidated_memory":"ISSUE: Message redelivery in worker/queue/consumer.py (background jobs side)
SYMPTOM: Same message id handled more than once
REPRO: Kill the worker mid-batch and restart it

OCCASION 1: [2026-03-29]
- Trigger: Tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR: #9622 on branch fix/message-redelivery-2
- Result: 13 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

OCCASION 2: [2026-05-13]
- Trigger: Staging read replica only
- Root cause: Schema drift between migration and model
- Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- PR: #9653 on branch fix/message-redelivery-3
- Stack: Python
- Covering check: tests/worker/test_consumer.py
- Result: Job finished in 65 minutes instead of 7 hours"}
